title: Release streamy 0.2.0
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [ ] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_streamy.html)
* [ ] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [ ] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [ ] `devtools::build_readme()`
* [ ] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [ ] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [ ] `revdepcheck::cloud_check()`
* [ ] Update `cran-comments.md`
* [ ] `git push`
* [ ] Draft blog post
* [ ] Slack link to draft blog in #open-source-comms

Submit to CRAN:

* [ ] `usethis::use_version('minor')`
* [ ] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [ ] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [ ] Accepted :tada:
* [ ] Finish & publish blog post
* [ ] Add link to blog post in pkgdown news menu
* [ ] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [ ] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [ ] Share on social media

title: show progress even when no chunks are ready yet
description: Especially with local models or slow internet connections, it can take a couple seconds before responses start streaming in. Watching a user yesterday, it seems like this is long enough to doubt that anything's actually happening.

title: make sure that response is selected with non-Replace interface
make it easier to "undo" after streaming
description: Because responses are streamed in, Cmd+Z just undoes the stream one token at a time. Maybe when the generator is done streaming we can quickly copy + paste in place so that Cmd + Z will restore to the previous text?
